'MINNIE THOUROUGH' — last name may be 'Thorough' or 'Thurough'; transcribed as printed. 'LEM WHEDBER' — last name uncertain, may be 'Whidber' or similar; transcribed as printed. 'LULA VANCLAVE' — last name may be 'Van Clave'; transcribed as printed. Some names (Annie Walker, Robert Walker, etc.) appear to repeat from page 5.
